rows.en: Hee hee… If that happens, naturally we get to ride for free, right?

Hahahaha… Peace is nice, isn't it.

It's not decided yet, but if I can take everyone on a flight, I'll put up with it, since that's part of peace too!

But… just because we beat Gorgom doesn't mean the other organizations are gone! For now, it's still…

What do you think, [HERO2]?
"Sounds good to me, doesn't it?" "It's true there are the other organizations to think about, for now…"
"Doesn't that sound good?" "It's true there are the other organizations to think about, for now…"

…You think so?

Well, even if something happens, I can rush right over… All right, I'll ask Shinmei about it! Thanks, everyone!

…Yeah, you're right.

Until true peace comes, I can't chase my personal dreams! I'll turn Shinmei down!
Uuugh… N-Nobuhiko…

…!?

The King Stones are calling to each other!? It can't be… Nobuhiko… Shadow Moon… are you alive!? Nobuhiko!

Hello, Amigo…

Oh, what's this? Is that you, Jiro?
What did you say!?

What!? A monster you've never seen before?

All right, understood! Jiro, get somewhere safe! Got it?
Something's happened to Jiro, hasn't it?
According to a report from Jiro and the Boy Rider Squad, a monster has appeared in town and is running wild! Kotaro, sorry, but…
Hey, [HERO2]! Kotarooo!
Heh heh heh… Hahahaha!
Hm? What's wrong, Kotaro… You're not yourself today.

Eh!? Ah, Oyassan…

The truth is… I had a strange dream.
A strange dream?
Yes… Nobuhiko was ali…
Big trouble! Shadow Moon is alive! He's running wild in town right now!

Shadow Moon!?

Hey, Taki… what are you talking about?

He's supposed to be dead, isn't he? Unless some miracle happened… Right, Kotaro?
…Nobuhiko!
Hey, Kotaro! Kotarooo!
Heh heh heh… Kotaro Minami… no, Kamen Rider BLACK!
Impossible!? That's impossible! Nobuhiko, Shadow Moon, is supposed to be dead!
Heh heh heh… This child is in my hands now! Look!
Brother Kotaro! Help meee!

M-Masaru!

Wait! Please, wait! Are you really Shadow Moon? You were alive?
If you want to save him, fight me!
Answer me, Nobuhiko! Nobuhikooo!
Who are you people?
Kotaro Minami… Kamen Rider BLACK!
They know who I am!? They don't seem to be Gorgom… Here I come! Hen… shin!
Why!? I can't transform???
Kotaro, what's wrong? A new enemy has shown up!
Kotaro, what's wrong? A new enemy has shown up!

Nobuhiko… Are you really set on fighting me?

Are you going to bring that nightmare back to life again? Nobuhikooo!
I… don't want to fight you, Nobuhiko! I don't want to fiiight!
Answer me, Nobuhiko! Say something!

My name is Shadow Moon!

Kamen Rider BLACK… I am the messenger of death, returned from hell to bury you!
Stop it, Nobuhiko! Stop!
You can't transform… what does that mean, Kotaro?
I don't know…??? I'd like to know myself!
Haven't you just gone soft from all the peace?
You can't transform!? Why not, Kotaro!
Maybe you let your guard down, relieved after beating Gorgom?
It's nothing like that! Some great power… that power is blocking my transformation…
Uwaaaaah…
Kotaro!?
Kotaro… vanished…?
Kotaro… vanished…?
So this is Kamen Rider BLACK? Hmph, he's not as tough as they say!
Why does General Jark want to meet a man like this? I don't think he's worth that much…

We analyzed every one of Kamen Rider BLACK's abilities by computer.

And we perfected a powerful beam that shuts down this man's transformation function. So naturally this man is no match for us!

But the General has his own ideas… You'd better watch your mouth!
GET UP! GET UP!

…………

…!? Who are you people?
I won't tolerate such a rude attitude! Kneel! General Jark has something to say to you.
Are you kidding me! Who do you think you are?
Kneel, I said!
Whoa!?
ATTENTION, ATTENTION! GENERAL JARK, GENERAL JARK!

…!?

So you're General Jark?

We are the ones sent to this land from the Crisis Empire, ruled by the almighty, all-knowing god, the Crisis Emperor!

My name is Jark!
Crisis Empire or whatever, I don't know, but quit this nonsense!
Wherever these glowing stakes stand, there our Crisis Empire exists!

What!?

What do these glowing stakes mean, anyway?
We have decided to rule the Earth using Japan as our strategic base, and build a new Crisis Empire.
In one year, five billion people from our homeland will come to this Japan.
Are you kidding me! If that many come, what do you think will happen to the people of Earth?
People? Hahahahaha…

We'll wipe out every last human! I can't stand anything about humans!

They rule this Earth, acting like they're the kings of the universe…

And meanwhile, we've lived shut away in a dark, twisted space for thousands of years!

Watching all along… humans living without a care, in the sunlight, blessed with clean water!
Where on earth is the Crisis Empire?
Our homeland, the Crisis Empire, is an empire that is on the Earth, yet not on the Earth…
Ugh!

Kotaro… someday the time will come when you too will understand what I mean…

If the Earth is left to humans, before long it will perish… But we can build an ideal kingdom on the Earth!

What do you say, Kotaro… Will you become our vanguard and work for the Crisis Empire?
Kotaro, if you agree, we'll give Kamen Rider BLACK twice the power he's had until now!
You're just a cyborg in the end, you know… No reason for you to stay loyal to the humans, right?

Sure, I'm a cyborg! But… I still think of myself as human!

I love humans! I'd die before I'd join a scheme to destroy them!
No matter what?
